agent.problem: The words "this is how" point back to the treatment described on story card 6, which is no longer on screen. The question never says what that treatment was, so it does not give enough context on its own.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.

agent.problem: This is a which-trees question, but "The tallest trees near the walls" and "Any tree the city planted itself" are invented categories rather than real details from somewhere in the Bible.

rule.text: For who, which thing and where questions, wrong answers are real details from somewhere in the Bible, like Joppa when the right answer is Tarshish.
